main_text.head: DE CONIUNCTIONE CIVITATIS GRONINGÆ
CUM ULTRAIECTINIS.
main_text.p: PRIMAM sub hoc nomine mentionem ejus in probatis & fidis literarum monumentis (nam de tabulæ Romanæ ætate ac fide cur dubitem, [InHisto-ria & li-bell.deOri gin.& Ant tiq. Frisi. Vide omni nō ad cal-cem.] demonstratum à me alibi est) usurpatam invenio in instrumento quodam donationis, quod est in tablino Ecclesiæ Ultraje-ctinæ, scripto & signato anno Christi M. XL: quo in instrumento Henricus III Imperator, cognomento Niger, filius Conradi II Salici, eidem Ecclesiæ tempore Bernoldi præsulis confert jus prædij, quod ipse in villà GRONINGA videbatur possidere. Quâ de donatione pauca dicam, ut & antiquitatem & veritatem in hac re illustrem. Cùm Normanni vastatores totius tractus maritimi Ultrajectum quoque occupassent, sacraque & profana illic diripuissent, cuncta ferro & flammâ pessum dedissent, succesforesque

page.notes: The page is a single printed page of text with one heading block. Doubtful readings: the macron on "nō" in the marginal note is read from a small mark and may be an acute or tilde; the spacing in the note ("Ant tiq.", "bell.deOri gin.&") follows the printed line breaks, which are hard to read. "GRONINGA" is set in small capitals within the italic phrase and is copied in roman capitals. The printed hyphen in "Ultraje-ctinæ" is taken from the line end. Spelling of u/v and i/j was normalised in capitals (CUM, ULTRAIECTINIS, URBE, CONIUNCTIONE). The word "succesforesque" is as printed. The small watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and was left out.
